A Letter For You
Happy Birthday Dianne,

First of all, we love you, me, your cousin, your friends, and those who surround you. You are appreciated by everyone you care about, you mean so much to us. The time you spend with us, and the memories we created will always have a special place in our heart.

We’ve been together for a year, and honestly, I’m more than grateful you came into my life. The memories we made, the times we argue, those moments that we are embarrassed to show what we truly feel to each other, those things that made us who we are now. In the infinite universe with countless possibilities, I would never want to trade those memories and experiences we had, with anything.

There have been happy times, awkward moments, arguments, random conversations, personal problems, and countless memories that I'll always keep close to my heart.

On your special day, my wish for you is to continue to be who you are, keep your beautiful smile, do what you want with your hair, maglagay ng pantal sa balat mo, chase your dream like going to UP, gumala, mag hb kasama mga pinsan mo, manood ng twilight yearly, magbasa ng BL, mapikon ng mabilis, and many more. You are who you are, and you’re irreplaceable in my heart, keep being pretty, and keep being the princess that you are. We love you, and I love you the most.

Im grateful to have you in my life, and I’m sure I’m not the only one who appreciate who you are. Happy birthday to you Ysang.

— Rain ❤️
